newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIAN HEADLINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 3.
newsitem.headline: INDIAN HEADLINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 3.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors affecting Indian stock markets on Thursday morning.
NEWS OUTLOOK:
** Court hearings begin in a forgery case in which federal police have filed charges against former former prime minister P.V. Narasimha Rao
** Second phase of local elections in northern Uttar Pradesh, India's most populous state
** U.S. firm Montgomery Funds said it launched the Montgomery Emerging Asia Fund which will focus on long-term economic growth predicted in China, Hong Kong, Singapore, Thailand, and India
Montgomery manages 18 no-load funds, and has about $7
billion under management. The fund will be at least 65 percent invested in equities
** The spot dollar/rupee INR= fell to 35.58/60 per dollar in early trade after opening little changed at 35.65/66, as a leading bank sold dollars, dealers said
MARKETS:

** Shares are expected to stay range-bound in sluggish trade with no fresh news to push market. The bourses across India were closed on Wednesday for a national holiday to mark the birth anniversary of Mahatma Gandhi
On Tuesday, share prices drifted lower in dull trade
with most participants staying on the sidelines
** The 30-share Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) index
declined 12.68 points, or 0.39 percent, to 3,226.80
** The 100-share National index eased 2.41 points, or 0.17 percent, to 1,477.43
** The 50-stock National Stock Exchange index dropped 7.69 points to 936.27
** The 500-share CRISIL index was off 2.76 points, or 0.44 percent, at 623.44
** The Delhi share index dropped 2.50 points to 719.74
** The Calcutta index shed 1.23 points to 423.38
** The Madras index fell 1.44 points to 3,373.27
** The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR Index slipped 0.04 points, or 0.06 percent, to 65.00 on Wednesday with the premium over the local market at 8.49 percent
